summary: Settings pages for R3 per PLAN §1.6.3/K12: PageTurningPage (넘기는 방식 first with probeAsync and 스크롤 움직임, SCROLL swipe summaries and disabled 세로 스와이프, 좌우/상하 여백 steppers with live region and shared note, 페이지 나눔 chooser, new 상태 표시줄 section with 6 slot rows, 진행 막대, size row and A §2.7 fit note, e-ink last); MainPage (서재 보기 chooser texts, 목록 넘기기, brightness rows with permission flow and verdict reset, 인용문 색 표시 with swatch strip, K12 reset keeping autoBackup/recordLookups/brightnessDevice/listPaging); BackupPage 자동 백업 section + privacy/merge notes; AboutPage 조명 진단 with 30 s change watch; LookupPage 단어장; polish 12 (no section hairline, 24 dp GRAY chevron/▾, filled off knob, disabled rows unavailable). Pure texts in R3Rows/SettingsReset with JVM tests.
checks: module typecheck --own ui/settings green; module unittest OK (87 tests); full tools/typecheck.sh green; full tools/unittest.sh OK (1204 tests). Two reviewer passes; findings fixed.
contractRequests: DA-C AutoBackup.findCandidates: S §3.8 [Δ] wants the BackupPage list to include this install's own auto files; the frozen KDoc says other installs + manual exports only. Either include own files (e.g. a flag) or add a variant; BackupPage calls findCandidates(context) unchanged.

DA-C AutoBackup: a count of the files deleteFiles(others) would delete (for the confirm's {n}); BackupPage counts them itself today (directory listing with all-files access, MediaStore Downloads RELATIVE_PATH query otherwise).
EX-S QuoteSwatch: MainPage builds QuoteSwatch(ctx, style, 22, ink) with 22×14 dp LayoutParams for the static strip; the view should draw to its measured size (not a square sizeDp).
rcaNotes: No ReaderActivity call is needed for the settings pages; they save through Settings.saveApp/saveReader, and the reader picks up a.readMode, a.scrollStyle, a.highlightLook, a.brightnessDevice via viewPart()/onAppSettingsSaved (C21) and r.* margins/pageBreak/slots/progressBar via the normal reader-settings relayout (anchored, A §5).

MainPage '기기 밝기 직접 조절' only stores AppSettings.brightnessDevice (after canWrite is granted); it does not call DeviceLight.restore() while turning it off — LightController/DeviceLight must restore/apply on the reader's next onResume according to brightnessDevice/brightnessRestore.
MainPage '밝기 방식 다시 확인' calls DeviceLight.setVerdict(appCtx, VERDICT_UNKNOWN) on IO; the reader must re-read verdict(ctx) on onResume (LightController.onResume) rather than caching it for the process.
Choosing 스크롤 in settings starts DeviceClass.probeAsync when cached() is null, so ScrollReader's AUTO resolves from the cache on the next open.
deviations: 스크롤 움직임 labels use the frozen ScrollStyle enum ('손가락을 따라 이동', '손을 떼면 이동') instead of S §1.2's '부드럽게 (휴대폰)'; AUTO reads '자동 (이 기기: e-ink → 손을 떼면 이동 | 휴대폰 → 손가락을 따라 이동)'.
A null device class (before the probe) resolves like a phone in every '자동 (이 기기: …)' summary, matching QuoteLook, ListPaging.paged and ScrollReader.
The 일반 section keeps the existing '모든 파일 접근 권한' row (not in the §1.6.3 list) so the grant stays reachable from settings.
'밝기 방식 다시 확인' uses UI_SPEC §4.6's summary, not brightness.md §5.6's variant.
'목록 넘기기' shows the value and the N §11 summary on one line ('자동 (이 기기: 쪽 단위) · 서재와 독서 노트를 한 화면씩 넘깁니다 (e-ink 권장)') since a valueRow has one summary line.
EinkToggle off knob radius stays track/2 − 4 dp (same as the kit InkToggle) rather than − 3 dp.
